lines: But the maṇḍala is for making mantras present and satisfied; and on the following day the worship of gods is not directly helpful for this.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mantrasaṃnidhisaṃtṛptiyogāyātra tu maṇḍalam bhūyodine ca devārcā sākṣānnāsyopakāri tat
